purpose: Give a formal explanation or excuse based on a circumstance.
keywords: Plain clause + こととて; N + の / な-adjective + な + こととて
I am inexperienced, so please forgive any discourtesy.
It was sudden, so I could not prepare fully.
Knowing nothing about it, I asked an irrelevant question.
formation: Plain clause + こととて; N + の / な-adjective + な + こととて
restrictions: Often softens a request for understanding or forgiveness.
mistake: Its apologetic literary tone is unusual in everyday chat.
